about: A short notice the PrompTugal app shows at the top of Now, only between show_from and show_until (UTC). Plain text, no HTML. Owned by correspondent@PrompTugal.dinis; keep it in step with the front page and the linked article. To remove it, set show_until in the past.
title: No summit on Wednesday
lines: Web Summit has called off Day 2, Wednesday 11 November, on the government's advice. It aims to hold Day 3 on Thursday as planned.
IPMA has red warnings for the Lisbon district on Wednesday: wind from 12:00 to 21:00, with gusts up to 120 km/h, and rain from 12:00 to 18:00.
The government asks people to stay at home where possible. Follow IPMA and civil protection. Emergency: 112.
sources: Web Summit, IPMA open data and the Government of Portugal, read 10 November 2026 at 21:34 UTC.
